cache_contract.do_not_claim: Disabling is explicitly specified; an automatic invalidation mechanism is not separately described. Do not borrow L012 bit5 or claim silicon coherency testing.

required_implementation_guards: Only exact qualified memory ranges; aliases/generic profiles fail closed. F030F6P7 has 32768 bytes despite shared manual 65536-byte maximum.
0x5a5a key accompanies each CR1/CR2/PAGELOCK write. Preserve WAIT and STANDBY; no controller reset.
One 512-byte erase page; F002/F003 groups are 2048 bytes, other qualified families 4096 bytes. Use the actual target page range and preserve unrelated legal lock bits.
Error mask 0x13; ICR W0C direct writes, never W1C or read-modify-write. A clear image 0x0c preserves reserved bits3:2 at their documented reset image and leaves high reserved bits zero.
Replace MODE bits with 1 or2; never OR a saved MODE, never restore a stale non-Read MODE. MODE=3 means chip erase on F002/F003/L052/baseline.
Verify cache disabled before trigger and WAIT unchanged. Cache restore only after BUSY=0 and MODE=Read. Cache failure is reported rather than ignored.
Reject unsupported WAIT encodings above2 for these nine families; use actual worst-case HCLK and sustained board supply bounds.
Keep unique unsafe reserved-region ownership, zero-address-safe raw byte access, fully-erased preflight, completed-operation verification and fail-closed cleanup.

Keep blocking-only explicit write/erase plus ReadNorFlash. No NorFlash power-loss containment, MultiwriteNorFlash, full-array-safe API, security setters, chip erase, DMA, EOP IRQ, timeout abort or board-test claim.
